actions.name: compromise victim network
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 ransomware compromises victim networks through a variety of techniques, including, but not limited to, purchased access, unpatched vulnerabilities, insider access, and zero day exploits.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: use Mimikatz to escalate privileges
actions.description: After compromising a victim network, LockBit 2.0 actors use publicly available tools such as Mimikatz to escalate privileges.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: exfiltrate data using publicly available and custom tools
actions.description: The threat actors then use both publicly available and custom tools to exfiltrate data followed by encryption using the Lockbit malware.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: encrypt data using LockBit malware
actions.description: The threat actors then use both publicly available and custom tools to exfiltrate data followed by encryption using the Lockbit malware.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: leave ransom note in each affected directory
actions.description: The actors always leave a ransom note in each affected directory within victim systems, which provides instructions on how to obtain the decryption software.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires an isolated, versioned Windows AD DC/member fixture; OS/AD versions and topology are missing. No version is assumed.

actions.name: threaten to leak exfiltrated victim data on LockBit 2.0 leak site
actions.description: The ransom note also threatens to leak exfiltrated victim data on the LockBit 2.0 leak site and demands a ransom to avoid these actions.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: automatically encrypt devices across Windows domains by abusing Active Directory group policies
actions.description: In July 2021, LockBit 2.0 released an update which featured the automatic encryption of devices across windows domains by abusing Active Directory group policies.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires an isolated Windows AD DC/member VM fixture and native health checks; this deployment environment has no VM backend/image configured.

actions.name: advertise for insiders to establish initial access
actions.description: In August 2021, LockBit 2.0 began to advertise for insiders to establish initial access into potential victim networks, while promising a portion of the proceeds from a successful attack.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: develop Linux-based malware targeting VMware ESXi virtual machines
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 also developed a Linux-based malware which takes advantage of vulnerabilities within VMWare ESXi virtual machines.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: decode strings and load required modules to evade detection
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 is a heavily obfuscated ransomware application leveraging bitwise operations to decode strings and load required modules to evade detection.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: determine if process has administrative privileges and escalate if not
actions.description: Upon launch, LockBit 2.0 determines if the process has administrative privileges. If privileges are not sufficient, it attempts to escalate to the required privileges.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: check system and user language settings and exit if Eastern European language detected
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 determines the system and user language settings and only targets those not matching a set list of languages that are Eastern European. If an Eastern European language is detected, the program exits without infection.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: delete log files and shadow copies on disk
actions.description: As infection begins, LockBit 2.0 deletes log files and shadow copies residing on disk.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: enumerate system information including hostname, host configuration, domain information, local drive configuration, remote shares, and mounted external storage devices
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 enumerates system information to include hostname, host configuration, domain information, local drive configuration, remote shares, and mounted external storage devices.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: attempt to encrypt data on local or remote devices excluding core system files
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 attempts to encrypt any data saved to any local or remote device but skips files associated with core system functions.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: delete itself from disk and create persistence at startup
actions.description: Once completed, LockBit 2.0 deletes itself from disk and creates persistence at startup.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: exfiltrate files using Stealbit application
actions.description: Prior to encryption, LockBit affiliates primarily use the Stealbit application obtained directly from the Lockbit panel to exfiltrate specific file types.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: configure Stealbit to target desired file path and copy files to attacker-controlled server using HTTP
actions.description: The affiliate configures the application to target a desired file path and, upon execution, the tool copies the files to an attacker-controlled server using http.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: use other commercially available tools such as rclone and MEGAsync for exfiltration
actions.description: Due to the nature of the affiliate model, some attackers use other commercially available tools such as rclone and MEGAsync to achieve the same results.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: use publicly available file sharing services for system compromise or exploration
actions.description: Lockbit 2.0 actors often use publicly available file sharing services including, privatlab[.]net, anonfiles[.]com, sendspace[.]com, fex[.]net, transfer[.]sh, and send.exploit[.]in.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: delete shadow copies using vssadmin and wmic commands
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 deletes all shadow copies on disk to prevent data recovery using commands such as 'vssadmin Delete Shadows /All /Quiet' and 'wmic shadowcopy delete'.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.

actions.name: disable Windows 10 recovery and ignore boot failures
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 disables Windows 10 recovery and configures the system to ignore boot failures using bcdedit commands.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: delete Windows event logs
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 deletes security, system, and application event logs using wevtutil commands.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM; Windows release and validated image are missing. Supply the release and lawful image reference; no version is assumed.

actions.name: wipe and delete itself
actions.description: LockBit 2.0 wipes and deletes itself using commands involving ping, fsutil, and Del.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Catalogue has no exact component/version and safe validation mapping for this action; provide the target software, version, and expected evidence.
